query: SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'jobType',job_type,'queue',queue,'status',status::text,'priority',priority,'attemptCount',attempt_count,'maxAttempts',max_attempts,'version',version,'runAfter',run_after,'updatedAt',updated_at) ORDER BY created_at DESC),'[]'::jsonb) FROM ops.jobs
